Question: What is the problem with Indian teachers?
Answer: I have had so many good teachers in my life. They taught me things that was beyond their subjects. I love and respect them a lot for what they have done for me and my classmates. You can never forget a good teacher. Not everyone gets them. If you have even one, who cares about you more than their monthly paycheck then you are in good hand and you are very lucky. Being said that, I do want to highlight something here — It was all partiality. Wasn't it? But why were teachers being partial? Was it on based on marks and ranks? Based on decency of some over others? Based on looks? Based on hw completion on time? Based on the respect they gave to teachers? Based on what………… exactly? Well, the answer is simple. Because all of these so called 'chosen one students' where children of teachers. They were not given special treatment because they were better but just because one of their parent was teacher. And those teachers wished to see there children on the stage, holding the mic and taking all the attention. And the next day they would be putting a what's app status on it. I mean WHAT THE HELL!!!!!!!!!!!!!! And believe me when I talked to their children about it, most of them, not all but most of them didn't even liked it. In fact they despised it. They didn't wanted to go on stage or hold the mic. They didn't liked their unfair advantage over other. Some of them even told me that this behaviour of their parents is making their friends hate them and other students don't see them as friends anymore. They see them as threat who take their fair opportunities by unfair means….. I feel like This is the biggest problem. Teachers needs to stop being partial like this. They are not doing any good to their children like this and also the student who deserves the chance should be given the chance…. Evara 🌻

Question: What is something you wish people knew?
Answer: I wish people knew how to communicate. And just express their emotions as it is. Without sugarcoating them, without thinking 'what would she think?’ Just say it dude! I wish people knew that I can't read mind. So if you hate me or love me, if you are upset from me, if you think that there is something that I did wrong. Just tell me! Instead of telling people around me…… I wish people knew this simple thing that to make any sort of relationship work, they need to say problems out loud in order to solve them. I hate it when, people I love just expect me to know everything. What sort of immaturity is this? I am not a god………… I can figure out that you are upset or that you are mad or that you need help or that you need space or that you don't want anything to do with me anymore or whatever the hell it is…………… But I can't figure out the….whyyyyyyyyyy? Unless you tell me…….. I might be at wrong but I wouldn't know it until you tell me. I might be misunderstood but you wouldn't know it until you tell me. Oh my god! This is seriously so annoying! When I keep asking them — is everything okay? Are you okay? Are you fine? Did anything go wrong? Do you want to talk about it? And they be like — no, I am fine. ( When they are not) When I finally accept that they are fine ( as they themselves said) and I stop giving them attention. I don't know what the hell get into them that they would tell the world about what went wrong or how I hurt their feelings but not me…… JUST FREAKING COMMUNICATE !!!!!!!!!!!!! Evara 🌻

Question: What makes you different?
Answer: In the world where people are running after excellence, I am good at nothing………… But……….. I can do everything……… Does that make sense? I mean when I look around, everyone is extremely good at that one thing that they take ahead and then make it their career. For example, Study, art, dance, sports etc. But I am just average but the good thing is I am average at everything. Sort of like, master of none but Jack of all. I think people like us are the most confused people in life. Because we know for a fact that we can thrive at everything but we don't have that one thing that we can go after and be the best……… You know children do this, right? Sometimes they want to be a painter, sometimes singer, sometimes a teacher, sometimes pilot……… I will be 20 year old soon and I still do this bullshit. Funny? …………… Not so much, at times……… it's confusing to be able to do everything but be good at nothing….. If life was just about surviving somehow, I would have nailed it. unfortunately, it's a race. Just getting to the finish line doesn't matter, you have to be the first to cross it…. Evara 🌻

Question: How do you know someone's true personality?
Answer: I think the time we live in, people wear different mask with different people and in different situations. I mean I will just give you my example. I have a totally different personality when I am with my parents compared to the one I use when I am with my friends. There is one for totally strangers, there is one on Quora. there is one for literally everything, to an extent that sometimes I feel like I might be suffering from multiple personality disorder. But here's a thing, I don't think that any of these personalities are fake. I don't do extra efforts to be someone with someone, it comes naturally. In most cases it actually depends on the people I am with. How are they behaving, what is their aura like… Now, coming to the question about someone's true personalities…….. I don't think just because a person have different personalities that anyone of them is fake. They all can be true and that depends on you, how you choose to see them. Now, here is a personality which I call the main personality………. That is when you are just by yourself. You are not with anyone. At that time when nobody's aura and presence is influencing you, that I feel like you can call your core personality. But here's a catch again……. Only you can know your own core personality. Nobody can know your's and you can't know someone else's…. 😉 Evara 🌻
